sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE mes = 7), 2) AS ventas_julio, ROUND(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE mes = 12), 2) AS ventas_diciembre, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE mes = 12) - SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE mes = 7)) / NULLIF(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE mes = 7), 0), 1) AS cambio_pct_jul_dic FROM ventas WHERE categoria = 'Cervezas y vinos'
